title: [GMCP 203.020.02] Production path: GMCP server authoring SDK and plugin lifecycle
goal: Requirement GMCP-203-020-02. Implement the canonical state, types, and primary production path. Replace stubs, demo-only paths, duplicated semantics, and implicit ambient state; preserve compatible behavior through explicit adapters; and make the new path reachable from the shipped GMCP runtime. Vector outcome: A stable Susi-shaped authoring SDK builds local MCP servers, tools, resources, prompts, subscriptions, MRTR handlers, tasks and extensions with schema derivation, typed context, middleware, testing fixtures and hot reload. Plugins declare permissions and compatibility, initialize transactionally, unload without leaks, preserve no vendor types across the boundary, and ship runnable minimal through production examples. Done means production-path tests and retained evidence prove this work package; task closure or roadmap wording alone is not evidence.
limitations: Production path (`GMCP-203-020-02`) implements `ServerBuilder`, `sdk_schema!`, MRTR builders/capability guards, outer-to-inner `ToolMiddleware`, atomic `reload_catalog`, `PluginBundle` / `PluginPolicy` / `attach_plugin` / `unload_plugin`, `verify_pack_dir_for_sdk`, in-process duplex `TestHarness`, and runnable minimal-through-production examples wired into `GmcpServer`; subsequent vector stages (`T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-109`..`113`) add dedicated security/adversarial, transport-matrix, scale/budget, operations/CLI, and final `.M` mastery suites.

Per `docs/gmcp-roadmap.md`, `docs/gmcp/contract-203-020.md`, and zero-UI plan A9, Core ships zero bundled vendor plugin packs (`DEFAULT_PACK_ID = "default"`; curated packs live in Susi Commercial Apps), and `.agents/gmcp/evidence/VC-203-020.jsonl` plus `.agents/roadmap-verdicts/VC-203-020.json` stay absent until `T-CODEXGMCPROADMAP-113` (`.M` Mastery).

reuse.why: Built `ServerBuilder`, `sdk_schema!`, `ToolMiddleware`, `reload_catalog`, `TestHarness`, and transactional `attach_plugin`/`unload_plugin` directly over existing `GmcpService`, `StructSchema`, `TaskManager`, `ExtensionRegistry`, `StdioGate`, `BoundedLines`, and `susi_config::extensions::validate_manifest`/`verify_pack_integrity` rather than introducing parallel server or plugin runtimes.
